title: Canonical JSON serialization
responsibility: Serializes JSON-shaped values with sorted object keys at every depth while preserving array order.

inputs.name: canonicalJson.value
inputs.description: Value passed to the serializer; arrays retain their order, and each object's own enumerable string keys are sorted recursively. Undefined-valued object properties are omitted, while BigInt values and cycles or deep recursion can fail during serialization.

outputs.name: canonicalJson
outputs.description: Compact JSON text produced after recursively sorting object keys while preserving array order. For top-level undefined, a function, or a symbol, JSON.stringify returns undefined rather than a string; BigInt values and recursive cycles can throw.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: JSON.stringify throws when a BigInt value remains in the sorted result and cannot be serialized.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Recursive sorting can exhaust the JavaScript call stack for cyclic references or sufficiently deep input; no cycle detection is performed.
